query:
SELECT oa.id, oa.officeId, oa.dayOfWeek, oa.startTime, oa.endTime, oa.slotDuration, oa.isActive
FROM office_availability oa
JOIN sanad_offices o ON oa.officeId = o.id
WHERE o.slug = 'test-office-filters-1766758228421'
LIMIT 5
